findings.claim: Phase 1 fully defines source authority and merging.
findings.finding: It identifies an authoritative body and retained later changes, but does not require field-level precedence and independent decisions for ID/type, title, body, acceptance criteria, priority, status, scope layers, and mappings.

findings.claim: Phases 0 and 2 provide an atomic, fully reversible restoration.

findings.claim: Phase 3 addresses active AC and mapping debt without blind deletion.
findings.finding: The direction is sufficient if applied only after active/retired and scope-layer classification. It correctly requires concrete ACs, executable tests, VICE anchors, and explicit review of all 293 zero-AC records and 25 unmapped FRs.

findings.claim: Phase 4 establishes oracle integrity.
findings.finding: It pins revisions and patch hashes, demands non-perturbing instrumentation, and repairs native process, xvic snapshot, and C64 BA blockers before authority. Retain the explicit rule that hardware cannot silently override VICE.

findings.claim: Phase 6 dependency order is implementation-safe.
findings.finding: The listed order places CPU before memory/PLA and VIA/CIA before machine glue and video. Make the order explicit as oracle/harness; clock, bus, PLA and memory; CPU micro-ops/interrupts/steals; C64/VIC-20 machine glue; VIC-II/VIC-I; CIA/VIA/IEC/input; SID/audio; storage/tape/cart/media; reset/snapshot/determinism/pacing; UI, while allowing only documented dependency-driven exceptions.

findings.claim: Phase 7 defines complete lockstep proof.
findings.finding: It lists broad state coverage and fail-closed workloads, but does not explicitly define and version the event/state schema, first-divergence artifact, deterministic replay seed, periodic snapshot cadence, or binary-search minimization. Those are necessary for reproducible proof rather than a large comparison list.

findings.claim: Phase 8 is decision-complete for VIC-20 settings.
findings.finding: It correctly adds direct-set notification and behavioral visibility tests, but must also preserve SettingsProfileDto.Machine family metadata in MachineProfileOption, notify IsVic20Selected on direct set, profile refresh, and settings restore, test C64 to VIC-20 to C64 transitions, and state that uIEC remains general rather than VIC-20-only unless an approved FR changes it.

findings.claim: Phase 9 fully guards regeneration/publication.
findings.finding: Counts, maximum-deletion zero, readback, and rollback are necessary but insufficient. Compare every approved ID/type, title, body, AC text and satisfaction, priority, status, scope layer, and mapping edge before and after generation; abort and restore on any narrowing or unexpected mutation.

findings.claim: The plan fully handles active scope and retirement.
findings.finding: The live store has an effective-requirements/layer model, but the plan does not require raw-versus-effective comparison or record scopeStartLayerKey/scopeEndLayerKey decisions. Add effective product/local scope snapshots and use approved layer retirement where supported instead of conflating inactive with deleted.

r1AmendmentDisposition.note: R2 corrects the historical/current counts and source rule, subject to the typed-presence caveat.
Phase 0 freezes and hashes the required evidence and adds an inverse manifest.
Phase 4 pins oracle and shim hashes and requires non-perturbation before authority.
Per-ID authority exists, but independent field-level precedence remains missing.
Classification, placeholder rejection, owner decisions, and preservation are present.
Small atomic batches and inverse manifest do not yet provide staged full-set preview, invariants, and verified rollback.
Phase 3 requires concrete ACs and coverage and forbids blind deletion.

VICE remains the compatibility specification, including VICE bugs. Hardware/datasheets may expose discrepancies but cannot silently override VICE; divergence needs an explicit behavior FR and owner approval.
An order is named, but foundational memory/PLA and machine glue positions need correction.
Coverage and fail-closed prerequisites are present; explicit schema versioning, divergence receipts, replay, and minimization remain missing.
Notification and runtime visibility tests are present; machine-family metadata, all mutation paths, and uIEC scope remain underspecified.
Dry-run/count/deletion guards exist; field-by-field ledger comparison and automatic restore on any narrowing remain missing.

requiredPlanAmendments.requirement: State both global-ID and same-type presence counts. Record TEST-VIC-001 as a wrong-type-only TR placeholder in addition to the two duplicate IDs; make type integrity an invariant.
Replace 'exported from an already incomplete DB' with 'the generated export was incomplete/collapsed; pre-export DB versus exporter cause is UNKNOWN.' Make recovery cause-independent.
For every union ID, decide type, title, body, each AC, priority, status, scope start/end layers, and every mapping edge independently under an explicit source-precedence rule.

Before any write, produce an owner-approved staged full-set preview and exact before/after diff. Enforce count, type, ID, reference, placeholder, AC, mapping, scope, and maximum-deletion invariants. Apply at a defined commit boundary or with compensating rollback, stop on first mismatch, restore the full hashed preflight state, and verify the restore field by field.

Use the dependency order oracle/harness; clock/bus/PLA/memory; CPU micro-ops/interrupts/steals; machine glue; VIC-II/VIC-I; CIA/VIA/IEC/input; SID/audio; storage/tape/cart/media; reset/snapshot/determinism/pacing; UI. Document any exception.

Define and version a lockstep event/state schema, including comparison cadence and normalization. Retain first-divergence artifacts, deterministic replay inputs, periodic full snapshots, and binary-search minimization. Make the required Nuke/CI target fail closed for every prerequisite.

Carry authoritative SettingsProfileDto.Machine family metadata into MachineProfileOption. Raise IsVic20Selected for direct selection, profile refresh, and settings restore; test C64 to VIC-20 to C64 runtime visibility, focusability, and draft preservation. Keep uIEC general unless an approved FR says otherwise; exclude Xbox/UWP.

After generation, compare the approved ledger field by field for ID/type, title, body, ACs, priority, status, scope layers, and every mapping edge. Abort and automatically restore on any deletion, narrowing, wrong-type move, or unexpected mutation.

Snapshot raw and effective product/local requirements plus layer metadata. Define active versus retired from approved scope layers, and retire out-of-scope Xbox/UWP without deleting historical records.

Preserve the source hierarchy as a hard gate: pinned pristine VICE behavior is the compatibility contract, including VICE bugs. Hardware/datasheets may identify discrepancies but any intentional managed divergence requires an explicit observable behavior FR and owner approval.
